messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert (P1) — node gpu-12 hitting EPHEMERAL_STORAGE pressure, 3 modelcache pods evicted; several serve pods restarted and some show CUDA OOM on restart. Paging @oncall.

ashish: jumping on it. seeing repeated evictions and node flapping in the last 6m. kubectl shows a bunch of Evicted statuses.

ashish: grabbing quick outputs:
```shell
$ kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector=spec.nodeName=gpu-12
NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
modelcache-7d8f9c6d8-xtplk      0/1     Evicted   0          8m
modelcache-7d8f9c6d8-kqsv2      0/1     CrashLoopBackOff  4   7m
serve-worker-12-abc              0/1     Error     3          6m
```

ashish: dmesg/kern shows eviction and then CUDA errors on container start:
```text
kernel: Node has run out of resource: Ephemeral storage
kubelet: evicting pod modelcache-7d8f9c6d8-xtplk
container runtime: starting container: cudaInit failed: out of memory
serve: [error] CUDA out of memory while allocating 2147483648 bytes
```

kelsey: quick customer impact check — prod-router shows a spike in 500s and 504s for a few tenants around the same timeframe. UI errors reported by realtime customers A/B. Not widespread but user-facing for a subset :frowning:

emily: immediate mitigation plan (short):
1) cordon gpu-12 (prevent new scheduling)
2) drain non-critical logging-heavy pods (kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data)
3) reduce modelcache footprint on nodes that restart (set MODEL_CACHE_MAX=6G) and restart one replica at a time
4) temporarily lower logging level to INFO across the node
5) clean old logs in /var/log/modelcache and rotate

emily: commands I'm about to run:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-12
kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30
ssh node@gpu-12 'sudo find /var/log/modelcache -type f -mtime +2 -exec gzip {} \; -exec rm -f {}.old \;'
kubectl set env deployment/modelcache MODEL_CACHE_MAX=6G
```

ashish: cordon done, starting drain now — will evict noncritical first. output:
```text
node/gpu-12 cordoned
warning: ignoring DaemonSet-managed pods: kube-system/nvidia-drivers
evicting pod logging-agent-9f8s
evicting pod sidecar-debug-0
```

zack: FYI — looks like a recent change flipped a debug logging flag for modelcache last deploy -> logs ballooned to dozens of GBs. I'm rolling that change back in parallel.

marie: handing to @sre-shift-lead for customer comms and longer running mitigation. tagging support to prepare CS notes for affected tenants.

sre-shift-lead: taking. timeline note: initial detection -> evictions at 1765432083, mitigation started 1765432105. Current status: node cordoned, logs being cleaned, modelcache replicas being restarted at reduced cache size. Customer impact: partial 500s for TenantAlpha and TenantGamma; approx 5-7% of their traffic impacted, spike lasted ~10-15m before fallback routing kicked in. Opening incident channel and support tickets.

oncall-bot: Created #incident-1765432100-ephemeral-storage-runaway-logs (private) and posted to incidents.

ashish: cleaned ~42GB of old logs on gpu-12, restarting modelcache replicas one-by-one. verifying replicas steady: modelcache x 2 -> ready, third in progress.

emily: note on CUDA OOMs — they were mostly happening on immediate restart because modelcache tried to rehydrate large KV cache w/ limited free RAM after eviction. reducing MODEL_CACHE_MAX avoided the OOM. later we'll need a smoother cache warmup strategy.

zack: deployed rollback for debug logging flag :thumbsup:

sre-shift-lead: next steps (post-incident):
- fix: revert debug logging permanently and add a deploy guard
- fix: add ephemeral log quota on nodes (per-container log rotation enforcement)
- fix: tune kubelet eviction thresholds for modelcache nodes (give apps more headroom)
- action: add runbook entry for "runaway logs -> cordon/clean -> restart modelcache with cold-start limits"
- cs: send customer impact summary and mitigation timeline to CS for affected tenants

kelsey: TL;DR for channel: ephemeral storage filled by runaway debug logs -> kubelet evicted modelcache pods -> restarting replicas tried to load large caches and triggered CUDA OOM -> mitigations applied (cordon, clean logs, restart with smaller cache, rollback debug) -> customers partially impacted for ~10-15m; monitoring for stable for next 30m.

marie: thanks everyone — handoff complete. switching to monitoring mode; will update incident doc with timeline and artifacts. :white_check_mark:

sre-shift-lead: incident moved to "mitigated" status — continuing verification and will post postmortem once we have logs/metrics. assigning followups.
